import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced with sanitized content. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Format and sanitize a user-submitted blog entry for safe HTML display. Args: headline: The title of the blog post. text: The full body content of the blog post. Returns: A string containing the sanitized, well‑formed HTML representation of the blog post. Raises: TypeError: If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str): raise TypeError(f"headline must be a string, got {type(headline).__name__}") if not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError(f"text must be a string, got {type(text).__name__}") # Escape any HTML characters to prevent XSS or markup injection. safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Inject sanitized content into the template. formatted_html = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_html
